stories.title: Musk steekt miljoenen dollars in tussentijdse verkiezingen VS om Republikeinen in het zadel te houden

en.title: Musk invests millions of dollars in U.S. midterm elections to keep Republicans in power
en.summary: Elon Musk is investing millions of dollars in U.S. midterm elections to support Republican candidates.

stories.title: Cabaretprijzen voor Ruud Smulders, Lisa Ostermann en Yentl en de Boer

en.title: Cabaret prizes for Ruud Smulders, Lisa Ostermann and Yentl en de Boer
en.summary: The VSCD Cabaret Prizes were awarded to Ruud Smulders, Lisa Ostermann, Yentl en de Boer, and David Linszen for outstanding cabaret performances of the year.

stories.title: Cabaretiers Lisa Ostermann en Yentl en de Boer winnen hun tweede Poelifinario op rij

en.title: Cabarettists Lisa Ostermann and Yentl en de Boer win their second Poelifinario in a row
en.summary: Cabaret performers Lisa Ostermann and Yentl en de Boer have won their second consecutive Poelifinario award.

stories.title: Minister Hermans schrapt proef met echo na dertien weken vanwege te veel foutieve uitslagen

en.title: Minister Hermans cancels echo trial after thirteen weeks due to too many incorrect results
en.summary: Minister Hermans has terminated an ultrasound trial after thirteen weeks due to an excessive number of erroneous test results.

stories.title: Andere (online) supermarkten hebben het drukker door problemen bij Albert Heijn

en.title: Other (online) supermarkets are busier due to problems at Albert Heijn
en.summary: Competing supermarket chains are experiencing increased demand as Albert Heijn faces operational issues. Jumbo reports rising online orders and is scaling up capacity to handle potential customer shifts.

stories.title: Kabinet schrapt 13-wekenecho voor zwangeren per 2028 na kritische evaluatie Gezondheidsraad

en.title: Cabinet scraps 13-week ultrasound for pregnant women from 2028 following critical Health Council evaluation
en.summary: The Dutch government will discontinue the 13-week pregnancy ultrasound program starting 2028 based on a Health Council review. The evaluation found the scan's benefits did not justify its drawbacks.

stories.title: Minister volgt advies Gezondheidsraad en schrapt dertienwekenecho per 2028

en.title: Minister follows Health Council advice and scraps 13-week ultrasound from 2028
en.summary: Pregnant women will no longer have access to the 13-week ultrasound starting January 1, 2028. The experimental program for detecting fetal abnormalities will be discontinued, Health Minister Sophie Hermans announced.

stories.title: Minister Hermans schrapt 13-wekenecho voor zwangeren per 2028

en.title: Minister Hermans scraps 13-week ultrasound for pregnant women from 2028
en.summary: The 13-week ultrasound program for pregnant women ends January 1, 2028, as Health Minister Hermans announced. The experimental screening for birth defects showed inconsistent results with unnecessary referrals and missed abnormalities.

stories.title: Cyberincident hindert boodschappen doen bij Albert Heijn: 'Kan prijzen niet zien'

en.title: Cyberattack disrupts shopping at Albert Heijn: 'Cannot see prices'
en.summary: A cyber incident affecting parent company Ahold Delhaize has disrupted operations at Albert Heijn supermarkets. Display screens above shelves are non-functional and price tags are covered, preventing customers and staff from viewing product prices.

stories.title: Albert Heijn al bijna complete dag ontregeld door cyberincident, lege schappen dreigen

en.title: Albert Heijn disrupted nearly entire day by cyber incident, empty shelves threaten
en.summary: Albert Heijn supermarkets experienced significant disruptions due to a cyber incident affecting parent company Ahold Delhaize, potentially leading to supply shortages.

stories.title: Distributiecentra Albert Heijn plat door cyberincident, lege schappen dreigen

en.title: Albert Heijn distribution centers offline due to cyberattack, empty shelves looming
en.summary: Multiple Albert Heijn distribution centers have halted operations following a cyber incident at parent company Ahold Delhaize. The disruption threatens supermarket supply chains and potential stock shortages.

stories.title: Distributiecentra Albert Heijn stil na digitaal veiligheidsincident, kans op lege schappen

en.title: Albert Heijn distribution centers halted after digital security incident, risk of empty shelves
en.summary: Multiple Albert Heijn distribution centers have suspended operations following a cyber security incident, threatening store inventory. Fresh products in particular face potential shortages as preventive system shutdowns continue.
